notes.title: Super Space Serpent SE is on SHMUP FEST!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41886021/73f7430ea197bd3e901bf576386cc2f3ebc43099.png[/img]🎮🕹️, Super Space Serpent SE is part of the Steam SHMUP FEST 🕹️🎮 

We are happy to announce that Super Space Serpent SE is on 68% discount during the SHMUP FEST!
 Starting September the 25th.
